summary: Reworked natural_list in src/humanize/lists.py to accept any iterable. It now imports Iterable from collections.abc in the TYPE_CHECKING block, annotates items as Iterable[Any], builds item_list = [str(item) for item in items] once, and does all indexing/slicing/len on that list. Empty returns "", one item returns it, two return f"{a} and {b}", and more join all but the last with ", " then append f" and {last}". Docstring updated to 'Convert an iterable of items' with the Args line 'items (Iterable): An iterable of items.' Output for lists is unchanged. `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_lists.py` passed with 14 tests.
concerns: Only src/humanize/lists.py was modified; no other modules, locales, or docs touched.
No type-checking (mypy) run, only the specified pytest check; TYPE_CHECKING constant remains False as before.
Generators are consumed once into item_list, so behavior with one-pass iterables is consistent.
